name: Stormbringer: Lord of Lightning is granted by Storm Ascendance (#1137)
contract: #1137: Lord of Lightning 707618 is a passive whose single effect is an aura 42 proc casting the buff 801841 on the caster, with Description 'Storm Ascendance now additionally grants you Lord of Lightning for $801841d'. Its Spell.dbc ProcFlags are 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so no proc entry was generated and the aura could never proc; because the proc is the talent's only effect, nothing of it reached the player. The buff is pure native spellmods: effect 0 aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30 percent on class mask (0x100, 0x200010, 0), and effect 1 aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 17 SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3 on class mask (0x2000000, 0, 0). Electrocute 501421 carries SpellFamilyFlags (0x2000000, 0x200000, 0x20) and is matched by both masks; Shock 804020 carries (0x800, 0, 0) and is matched by neither, so it serves as the negative control. The fix is one spell_proc row admitting the proc on family 22 SpellFamilyFlags word 2 bit 0, a bit carried by exactly two Spell.dbc rows, Storm Ascendance 681110 and its companion 681187. Duration 20000 ms from SpellDuration.dbc row 18.
